$comment: The one source of the paid tiers. scripts/stripe-catalogue.mjs makes Stripe match this file and audits it; the tenant control plane reads the same limits. Amounts are in cents; a paid price is per seat (quantity = seats). Tiers approved 2026-09-22; the storage add-on (per 10 GB block, quantity = blocks) proposed the same day.

metering.$comment: PROPOSED 2026-09-22 -- NOT YET APPROVED BY THE OWNER, and neither are the connections / relay_gb_* limits on the tiers above nor the metered relay-overage price below. Until the SDK RelayGate exists the metered quantity is every byte a tenant sends INTO its object (bytes_in): each relayed byte arrives once, and control traffic is small beside it. gb_bytes: a billed GB is 10^9 bytes. max_frame_bytes: one WebSocket message larger than this closes the socket (1009), to protect the 128 MB isolate. flush_seconds: how often an object with open sockets writes its counters to its own storage.

metered.$comment: PROPOSED 2026-09-22, awaiting owner approval. Relay beyond a tier's included relay_gb is billed per whole GB through a Stripe Billing Meter. 5 cents/GB is Cloudflare Realtime TURN's list price, the relay a tenant would otherwise need; our own cost is at most $0.006/GB (docs/plans/tenant-quotas.md 1.3).
